title: Texas businessman loses home ownership battle despite presenting evidence of a $287K bank transfer
summary_full: A legal battle came to an end for a Texas entrepreneur who aimed to claim ownership of a property. The appellate court upheld the original ruling, stating that the evidence presented was inadequate to support a resulting trust. The testimony regarding a large bank transaction fell short of validating ownership, and the strict probate regulations limited the ability to appeal. Consequently, Karrie Peterson's estate retains the property.
